'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Kharkiv strikes (2022–present)|Kharkiv strikes]], [[Attacks on civilians in the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
****Five people are killed, including a child, and 35 are injured in a [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian]] [[drone warfare|drone attack]] on a residential area in [[Novobavarskyi District]] of [[Kharkiv]], [[Ukraine]]. [https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2025/04/4/7506067/ (''Ukrainska Pravda'')]
***[[Kryvyi Rih strikes (2022–present)|Kryvyi Rih strikes]]
****A Russian [[ballistic missile]] strike on a residential area in [[Kryvyi Rih]], [[Ukraine]], kills 19 people, including nine children, and injures more than 50 others. The [[Ministry of Defence (Russia)|Russian Defence Ministry]] says its forces were targeting a military gathering in the city. [https://edition.cnn.com/2025/04/04/americas/ukraine-strike-zelensky-russia-latam-intl/index.html (CNN)] [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c3wxe5g4z9yo (BBC News)] [https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2025/04/4/7506089/ (''Ukrainska Pravda'')] [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-missile-hits-residential-area-ukraines-kryvyi-rih-kills-12-2025-04-04/ (Reuters)]
*[[M23 campaign (2022–present)|M23 campaign]]
**[[2025 Walikale offensive]]
***The [[Democratic Republic of the Congo|Congolese]] media reports that [[March 23 Movement|M23]] rebels retreating from [[Walikale]] have arrived in [[Kibua]] in [[North Kivu]], Democratic Republic of the Congo. [https://www.criticalthreats.org/briefs/congo-war-security-review/congo-war-security-review-april-4-2025 (Critical Threats)]
*[[Syrian civil war]]
**[[Syrian peace process]]
***Groups of [[Kurds in Syria|Kurdish]]-led [[Syrian Democratic Forces]] (SDF) militants withdraw from the two neighborhoods of [[Sheikh Maqsood]] and Achrafieh in [[Aleppo]], [[Syria]], as part of a deal with the [[Syrian government]], which will eventually merge the SDF and the [[Syrian Armed Forces]] under one command. [https://apnews.com/article/syria-aleppo-sdf-sheikh-maksoud-achrafieh-withdrawal-9b8cd819c04b222a695455bb426f92df (AP)]
*[[Gaza war]]
**More than 30 people are killed in [[Israel]]i airstrikes in [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]]. [https://www.channel4.com/news/gaza-more-than-30-people-killed-in-israeli-strikes (''Channel 4 News'')]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Tariffs in the second Trump administration]]
**[[China–United States trade war]]
***[[China]] responds to [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]]'s [[tariff]]s with a 34% reciprocal tariff on imports of [[United States|American]] goods. The tariffs will take effect on April 10. [https://edition.cnn.com/2025/04/04/business/china-us-tariffs-retaliation-hnk-intl/index.html (CNN)]
**[[Donald Trump's Liberation Day speech]]
***Multiple companies, including [[Klarna]], [[StubHub]], [[Nintendo]], and [[Professional Sports Authenticator]], pause price-sensitive business actions in the U.S. to evaluate the impact of the recent tariff announcements. [https://www.wsj.com/livecoverage/stock-market-tariffs-trade-war-04-04-2025/card/exclusive-klarna-pauses-planned-ipo-after-trump-tariff-turmoil-NMXYuKXzW6Xv4ao3CSxr (''The Wall Street Journal'')] [https://www.ign.com/articles/nintendo-delays-switch-2-pre-order-date-in-the-us-to-assess-impact-of-trumps-tariffs (IGN)] [https://www.theverge.com/news/643117/psa-pausing-submissions-outside-us-tariffs (''The Verge'')]
***Stocks fall for the second consecutive day following Trump's recent tariff announcements. Over the past two days, the [[S&P 500]] is down over 10%, while the [[FTSE 100]] is down 6.97% for the week. [https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/live/2025/apr/04/us-business-stock-markets-nyse-blog-trump-tariffs-asian-markets (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Democratic Republic of the Congo–United States relations]]
**[[Lamuka]] opposition coalition spokesperson Prince Epenge criticizes the proposed minerals-for-security deal between the [[Democratic Republic of Congo]] and the [[United States]], describing it as a "sell-off." [https://www.criticalthreats.org/briefs/congo-war-security-review/congo-war-security-review-april-4-2025 (Critical Threats)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Kočani nightclub fire]]
**The death toll from the fire at a [[nightclub]] in [[Kočani]], [[North Macedonia]], in March increases to 60 as a [[burn]] victim dies in the hospital. [https://apnews.com/article/north-macedonia-nightclub-fire-kocani-lithuania-4ce73965f3b04957fd776e7151defdca (AP)]
*Ten people are killed when a [[landslide]] caused by torrential rains buries two vehicles in [[Mojokerto]], [[East Java]], [[Indonesia]]. [https://apnews.com/article/indonesia-landslide-java-eaf21c91d282c7618dde1cd44e67de33 (AP)]
*A bus carrying students and faculty from the [[Federal University of Santa Maria]] veered off a highway in [[Rio Grande do Sul]], [[Brazil]], killing seven and injuring 20. [https://menafn.com/1109395367/Fatal-bus-crash-in-Southern-Brazil-claims-lives-of-university-students-faculty (menafn.com.)]
*A van fell off a 50-meter ravine into a river in [[Sadanga]], [[Mountain Province]], [[Philippines]], killing five and injuring nine. [https://www.gmanetwork.com/regionaltv/news/107465/5-dead-9-hurt-after-van-falls-into-ravine-in-mt-province/story/ (GMA)]
'''Law and crime'''
*[[Impeachment of Yoon Suk Yeol]]
**The [[Constitutional Court of Korea]] unanimously upholds former [[President of South Korea|President]] [[Yoon Suk Yeol]]'s [[impeachment]] in an 8–0 vote, removing him from office. [https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/politics/20250404/s-koreas-president-yoon-suk-yeol-impeached (''The Korea Times'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Deportation of Kilmar Abrego Garcia]]
**[[United States federal judge]] for the [[United States District Court for the District of Maryland|District Court of Maryland]] [[Paula Xinis]] orders the [[second Trump administration|Trump administration]] to return Kilmar Abrego Garcia, a [[El Salvador|Salvadoran]] national from [[Maryland]] who was mistakenly [[deportation|deported]] and sent to the [[Terrorism Confinement Center]] in [[Tecoluca]], El Salvador. [https://apnews.com/article/el-salvador-deportation-maryland-man-trump-617bfac0e54b241fa2f54783bdf08628 (AP)]
*Thousands of people demonstrate in [[Bangui]], [[Central African Republic]], to protest against [[President of the Central African Republic|President]] [[Faustin-Archange Touadéra]]'s plans to run for a third term with the backing of the [[Russia]]n-led [[Wagner Group]], who has killed indiscriminately in the country. [https://apnews.com/article/central-african-republic-russia-wagner-d955ae10660d8dc5efdb258dd067be13 (AP)]
